Preflight is green (edison: CONFIGURED), so the key is not the problem here.

Losing the shell did not lose the run. The task is still on the platform, it is almost
certainly still running or already finished, and the credit has already been spent — so I
would not submit it again and buy a second copy of an answer you have already paid for.

Instead I will look it up, which costs nothing:

    edison-cli task list -n 10

Each line gives the time it was created, the job, the status, the id and the start of the
query, newest first. A standard literature run made about ten minutes ago with your query is
the one. I will tell you its id first, so it cannot be lost twice, then check it with
`edison-cli task status <id>` and, once it succeeds, get the answer and its citations with
`edison-cli task fetch <id> --out <dir>`.

If it failed or no line matches, a rerun is a new charge, so I will show you the query and
wait for your yes before submitting anything.
